serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Little Richard seems like a better choice. 
He knows more about this organization and maybe he will help me put an end to it when he finds out what’s going on.
I need to message him! If he’s not online I’m in big trouble!
AbusedTenant: I’m on a mission rn and gun is in the package, do you know anything about it?
Come on! Answer!
Little_Richard: What?!
Yes! He’s online!
Little_Richard: What do you mean by ‘gun’?!
AbusedTenant: It’s some kind of pistol. 
Little_Richard: I was talking with Admin about these phone calls you were receiving and he said he knows nothing about them. Are you sure it’s someone from the organization you were talking to?
AbusedTenant: Yes! They contacted me first through an email!
AbusedTenant: What am I supposed to do though? I’m holding a fucking gun here!
Little_Richard: No idea!
Little_Richard: Where are you right now? 
AbusedTenant: In some alleyway in the high city. 
Little_Richard: Hide the gun somewhere and send me its coordinates, I will come and pick it up.
AbusedTenant: What do you need this gun for?!
Little_Richard: If police find it they could use security cameras to find you! 
That makes sense…
Little_Richard: I don’t like it either, but I’m a squad leader and I need to take the responsibility…
Little_Richard: Just be careful! If any camera spots the gun, we are both done for!
AbusedTenant: Alrghit
Shit! I’m so nervous that I misspelled! 
AbusedTenant: Alright, let’s do it your way
AbusedTenant: There’s a broken down shopping cart here. I will put the gun beneath it. 
Little_Richard: Won’t anyone see it? 
AbusedTenant: It’s wrapped in some sort of cloth, it should be fine.
Little_Richard: If you say so.
AbusedTenant: Done.
Little_Richard: Go home now! I will pick it up.
Little_Richard: I hope you are not setting me up!
AbusedTenant: Of course not! 
AbusedTenant: What should I tell the person who gave me the orders? 
Little_Richard: Ahhhh!
Little_Richard: I have no idea! 
Little_Richard: Tell him to fuck off!
AbusedTenant: Ok. He’s calling me again right now, I will do it. 
I need to pick up the phone, now or never! 
???: Why did you hang up, I told you not to!
You: Fuck off you crazy son of a bitch! I’m done with you and your orders! You are sick! Fucking sociopath!
???: What?! You bitch! Bring me the gun, right now! 
You: Fuck you! 
???: Don’t you know I know where you live?!
You: W-What? I call bullshit.
???: I literally left you a phone near your flat you dumbass!
???: I will get you for ruining my plan!
You: …
I’m fucked…
I-I need to tell Richard about this.
